# Prepare environment
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=16, fig.height=8, dev=c('png', 'pdf'),
                       echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)

cfg <- params$cfg
stopifnot(!is.null(cfg))   # render through run_stage4.R so that params are passed
source(cfg$label_checks)   # shared/label_checks.R: labels from the deposited object, agreement with the rerun
unlink(file.path(params$step_dir, "label_agreement.tsv"))
```

# Packages
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(schex)
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(rmarkdown)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(SingleR)
```

# Load sts.non.malignant object
```{r}
# this object was generated based on re-running all the QC, sample-based analysis, non-malignant components were processed using non-integrative approach 
# this approach define small and rare cell classes that would be otherwise clustered with CAFs, eg. FRCs, Schwann and FDCs
sts.non.malignant <- read_nonmalignant(cfg$final_object)   # Stage 3 non-malignant cells and labels, from the deposited final object
```

# STROMAL CLASSES
```{r}
stromal <- sts.non.malignant %>% subset(Lv.2.Anno %in% c("CAFs","Pericytes", "FRCs", "Schwann","FDCs"))
```

## DE analysis by pseudobulk, comparing different class of stromal fibroblasts
## Stromal subsets
```{r echo=TRUE, include=FALSE}
#Ref: https://github.com/yunshun/HumanBreast10X/blob/main/RCode/NormTotal.R
DefaultAssay(stromal) <- "RNA"

# Converting cluster name into numerical
Idents(stromal) <- "Lv.2.Anno"
stromal@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno <- as.factor(stromal@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno)
print(levels(stromal@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
#[1] "CAFs"      "FDCs"      "FRCs"      "Pericytes" "Schwann"  

levels(stromal@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) <- 1:length(levels(stromal@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
print(1:length(levels(stromal$Lv.2.Anno)))
#[1] 1 2 3 4 5

ClusterSub <- as.factor(stromal@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) 
PatClust <- paste(stromal$Patient_ID, ClusterSub, sep = "_Clst") #labelling each cell with Sample#_Cls#
counts <- stromal@assays$RNA@counts #dgCMatrix
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
counts <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group=PatClust))

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
count.matrix <- DGEList(counts) 
count.matrix$samples$Patient <- gsub("_Clst.*$","", colnames(count.matrix)) #adding a new column, named Patient 
count.matrix$samples$Cluster <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*_Clst","",colnames(count.matrix))) #adding a new column, named Cluster
count.matrix$samples$group <- count.matrix$samples$Cluster
count.matrix #count matrix

ncls <- length(table(ClusterSub))
N <- 1:ncls #focus on all clusters
ClstSub <- count.matrix[,count.matrix$samples$Cluster %in% N] 
keep <- filterByExpr(ClstSub, min.count=5, min.total.count=10) #min=10, min.total.count=20
ClstSub <- ClstSub[keep, , keep=F]
ClstSub <- calcNormFactors(ClstSub) # to calculate normalisation factors to a algin columns of a count matrix
ClstSub$samples$group

# The original colours (stromal.color, stromal.col) were defined outside this file; these two MDS plots are checks only
stromal.col <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Set1")
plotMDS(ClstSub, pch = 16, col = stromal.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")

#Design matrix
Cls <- as.factor(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)
Pat <- factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient)
design <- model.matrix(~ Cls + Pat)

#Estimate NB dispersion & QL dispersion
ClstSub <- estimateDisp(ClstSub, design = design)
qfit <- glmQLFit(ClstSub, design)

contr <- makeContrasts(
    Cls1 = -(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4+Cls5)/4,
    Cls2 = Cls2-(Cls3+Cls4+Cls5)/4,
    Cls3 = Cls3-(Cls2+Cls4+Cls5)/4,
    Cls4 = Cls4-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls5)/4,
    Cls5 = Cls5-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4)/4,
    levels=design)

de <- list()
for (i in 1:ncls) de[[i]] <- glmQLFTest(qfit, contrast = contr[,i])

#log-CPM
prior.count <- 1
ClstSub.cpm <- edgeR::cpm(ClstSub, log=T, prior.count=prior.count) #calculating cpm

# Remove batch effect on log-CPM
# Ref: https://rdrr.io/github/richierocks/limma2/man/removeBatchEffect.html
logCPM_no_batch <- removeBatchEffect(ClstSub.cpm, batch = Pat, group = Cls) # following example on ?removeBatchEffect in R

boxplot(as.data.frame(ClstSub.cpm),main="Original")
boxplot(as.data.frame(logCPM_no_batch),main="Batch corrected")
plotMDS(logCPM_no_batch, pch = 16, col = stromal.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="Pseudo-bulk samples")

library(tibble)
names(de) <- colnames(contr)   # Cls1 ... Cls5
res_list <- lapply(names(de), function(cn) {
  topTags(de[[cn]], n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")$table %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(cluster = cn)
})
names(res_list) <- names(de)
all.stromal.pseudobulk <- bind_rows(res_list)
all.stromal.pseudobulk %>% mutate(cell_names = case_when(cluster == "Cls1" ~ "CAFs",
                                                     cluster == "Cls2" ~ "FDCs",
                                                     cluster == "Cls3" ~ "FRCs",
                                                     cluster == "Cls4" ~ "Pericytes",
                                                     cluster == "Cls5" ~ "Schwann")) -> all.stromal.pseudobulk
# Supplementary Table 6 (originally saved as stromal.subsets.pseudobulk_revisedFDR.csv)
write.csv(all.stromal.pseudobulk, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "SupplementaryTable6_stromal_pseudobulk.csv"), row.names = F)
```

# CAFS - reclustering
Simspec integrated analysis on CAFs only to define CAF subsets; SCTransform on individual samples
```{r}
sample.high.fib <- as.data.frame(sts.non.malignant@meta.data) %>%
                                 group_by(Sample) %>% 
                                 dplyr::count(Lv.2.Anno) %>% 
                                 dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "CAFs", n > 30) %>% 
                                 pull(Sample) %>% 
                                 as.character()
fib.only <- sts.non.malignant %>% subset(subset = Sample %in% sample.high.fib & 
                             Lv.2.Anno == "CAFs") # to make sure our population of CAFs is as pure as possible

fib.only <- fib.only %>% subset(subset = cell_class == "CAFs" & simspec_cell_class == "CAFs") # this extra step to ensure only reclustering fibroblasts, not lymphoid stromal or other fibroblast-like cells

# DietSeurat
DefaultAssay(fib.only) <- "RNA"
fib.only <- DietSeurat(fib.only, assays = "RNA", data = TRUE, counts = TRUE)

# to remove columns & because we need to split individual samples and redo the SCT
colnames(fib.only[[]]) #check which columns to remove
fib.only[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
fib.only[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
fib.only[["seurat_clusters"]] <- NULL
#fib.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.5"]] <- NULL
#fib.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.6"]] <- NULL
fib.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.7"]] <- NULL
#fib.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL

#Removing outliers (rare cancer types)
fib.only <- subset(fib.only, subset = Sample %in% c("1959","2185"), invert = T)
#fib.only$Sample <- droplevels(fib.only$Sample)

# SCTRANFORM
fib.only <- SplitObject(fib.only, split.by = "Sample") 
fib.only <- lapply(fib.only, FUN= SCTransform, vst.flavor="v2", assay = "RNA",
              variable.features.n = 3000, # default, have seen range from 2000-5000
              )

# SIMSPEC INTEGRATION
int.features.split <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = fib.only, nfeatures = 2000)
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- merge(x = fib.only[[1]], y = fib.only[2:length(fib.only)], 
                                  merge.data = TRUE)

VariableFeatures(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct) <- int.features.split

# PCA 
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- RunPCA(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, verbose = TRUE, assay = "SCT",
                                  npcs = 30) #default npcs = 50

# Run CSS ----
library(simspec)

# On running simspec_CSS on SCTranformed objects https://github.com/immunogenomics/simspec_CSS/issues/41
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <-
  simspec::cluster_sim_spectrum(
    object = fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct,
    label_tag = "orig.ident", #original sample labels from pre-processing step
    cluster_resolution = 0.4,
    corr_method = "pearson",
    spectrum_type = "corr_kernel"
  )

cat("Current reductions in object:", Reductions(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct)) # pca css
# Current reductions in object: pca css

# Reference codes from:  https://doi.org/10.17632/3kthhpw2pd 
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- RunUMAP(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, reduction = "css", 
                                   dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, "css")), #294
                                   reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_")

fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- FindNeighbors(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, reduction="css", 
                                         dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, "css")))

#fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- FindClusters(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, algorithm = 3,resolution = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1))
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- FindClusters(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, algorithm = 3,resolution = 0.1)

# clustree needs at least two resolutions; only 0.1 is run here (the wider sweep above is commented out)
#library(clustree)
#clustree::clustree(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct)

DimPlot(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.1", label = T) + DimPlot(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, group.by = "Lv.2.Anno",label = T)

Idents(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.1" 
saveRDS(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "fib.only.simspec.RDS"))
```

## DE analysis 
`Lv.2.Anno_subset` was assigned to the resolution-0.1 CAF clusters by number in the original analysis. Cluster numbers can change between environments, so it is read from the deposited object (`stage4_CAF_Lv.2.Anno_subset`), matched by cell ID. The original mapping is still applied to the rerun clusters, as `Lv.2.Anno_subset_by_cluster`, and compared with it. The UMAP plots of the CAFs (Fig. 1C, Extended Data Fig. 5A and 5B) use the stored coordinates (`stage4_CAF_UMAP_1`, `_2`); the rerun UMAP is kept as `umap_css_rerun`.

```{r caf-annotation, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
## Assign CAF clustering
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$seurat_clusters <- NULL
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$seurat_clusters <- fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$SCT_snn_res.0.1

metadata <- fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() 
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)
metadata %>% mutate(Lv.2.Anno_subset = case_when(SCT_snn_res.0.1 %in% c("0","2") ~ "CAFs_MYO", 
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.1 == "4" ~ "Vascular smooth muscle", 
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.1 == "3" ~ "CAFs_CXCL14+",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.1 == "1" ~ "CAFs_NRT", 
                                          )) -> metadata
stopifnot(identical(metadata$S_CB, colnames(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct)))
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_subset_by_cluster <- metadata$Lv.2.Anno_subset

# Lv.2.Anno_subset and the UMAP from the deposited object
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_subset <- deposited_labels(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, "stage4_CAF_Lv.2.Anno_subset")
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct@meta.data %>% group_by(SCT_snn_res.0.1) %>% dplyr::count(Lv.2.Anno_subset)
print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$SCT_snn_res.0.1, fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_subset,
                                    "CAFs: rerun clusters (res 0.1) vs Lv.2.Anno_subset", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_subset_by_cluster, fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_subset,
                                  "CAFs: Lv.2.Anno_subset by cluster vs deposited", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- use_deposited_umap(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, "stage4_CAF_UMAP")
saveRDS(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "fib.only.simspec.RDS"))

#DE analysis on these CAF subsets 
fib <- fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct
DefaultAssay(fib) <- "RNA"

# Converting cluster name into numerical
Idents(fib) <- "Lv.2.Anno_subset"
fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno_subset <- as.factor(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno_subset)
print(levels(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno_subset))
#[1] "CAFs_CXCL14+"           "CAFs_MYO"               "CAFs_NRT"               "Vascular smooth muscle"

levels(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno_subset) <- 1:length(levels(fib))
print(1:length(levels(fib$Lv.2.Anno_subset)))
#[1] 1 2 3 4

ClusterSub <- as.factor(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno_subset) 
PatClust <- paste(fib$Patient_ID, ClusterSub, sep = "_Clst") #labelling each cell with Sample#_Cls#
count <- fib@assays$RNA@counts #dgCMatrix
count <- as.matrix(count)
counts <- t(rowsum(t(count), group=PatClust))

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
count.matrix <- DGEList(counts) 
count.matrix$samples$Patient <- gsub("_Clst.*$","", colnames(count.matrix)) #adding a new column, named Patient 
count.matrix$samples$Cluster <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*_Clst","",colnames(count.matrix))) #adding a new column, named Cluster
count.matrix$samples$group <- count.matrix$samples$Cluster
count.matrix #count matrix

ncls <- length(table(ClusterSub))
N <- 1:ncls #focus on all clusters
ClstSub <- count.matrix[,count.matrix$samples$Cluster %in% N] 
keep <- filterByExpr(ClstSub, min.count=5, min.total.count=10) #min=10, min.total.count=20
ClstSub <- ClstSub[keep, , keep=F]
ClstSub <- calcNormFactors(ClstSub) # to calculate normalisation factors to a algin columns of a count matrix
ClstSub$samples$group

fib.col <- c("#DA9776","#A4DBCC","#B4A4D2","#ABE171")
plotMDS(ClstSub, pch = 16, col = fib.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")

#Design matrix
Cls <- as.factor(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)
Pat <- factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient)
design <- model.matrix(~ Cls + Pat)

#Estimate NB dispersion & QL dispersion
ClstSub <- estimateDisp(ClstSub, design = design)
qfit <- glmQLFit(ClstSub, design)

contr <- makeContrasts(
    Cls1 = -(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4)/3,
    Cls2 = Cls2-(Cls3+Cls4)/3,
    Cls3 = Cls3-(Cls2+Cls4)/3,
    Cls4 = Cls4-(Cls2+Cls3)/3,
    levels=design)

de <- list()
for (i in 1:ncls) de[[i]] <- glmQLFTest(qfit, contrast = contr[,i])

#log-CPM
prior.count <- 1
ClstSub.cpm <- edgeR::cpm(ClstSub, log=T, prior.count=prior.count) #calculating cpm

# Remove batch effect on log-CPM
logCPM_no_batch <- removeBatchEffect(ClstSub.cpm, batch=Pat, group = Cls) # for visualisation purposes only
plotMDS(logCPM_no_batch, pch = 16, col = fib.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")

library(tibble)
names(de) <- colnames(contr)   # Cls1 ... Cls4
res_list <- lapply(names(de), function(cn) {
  topTags(de[[cn]], n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")$table %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(cluster = cn)
})
names(res_list) <- names(de)
fib.subset.simspec.pseudobulk <- bind_rows(res_list)

fib.subset.simspec.pseudobulk %>% mutate(cell_names = case_when(cluster == "Cls1" ~ "CAFs_CXCL14+",
                                                                cluster == "Cls2" ~ "CAFs_MYO",
                                                                cluster == "Cls3" ~ "CAFs_NRT",
                                                                cluster == "Cls4" ~ "Vascular smooth muscle"
                                                        )) -> fib.subset.simspec.pseudobulk

# Supplementary Table 4 (originally saved as fib.subset.simspec_condense.pseudobulk_revisedFDR.csv)
write.csv(fib.subset.simspec.pseudobulk, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "SupplementaryTable4_caf_pseudobulk.csv"), row.names = F)
```

# UCELL SCORING against published CAF programs in PDAC
### Baron et al., 2016 - stellate programs
```{r ext-data-fig-5a-Baron, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Baron.fib.markers <- list() #http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2016.08.011
Baron.fib.markers$quiescent.stellates <- c("PDGFRB","SPARC","GJA4","CSPG4","EDNRB","RGS5","COL4A1")
Baron.fib.markers$activated.stellates <- c("COL1A1","FN1","THY1","LUM","TIMP1","MMP2")
Baron.fib.markers$immune.activated.stellates <- c("CXCL8","INHBA","FGF2","IL6","CSF3", "CXCL3","IL33")
Baron.fib.markers$Schwann.cells <-c("SOX10", "S100B" ,"CRYAB","NGFR","PLP1","PMP22")
library(UCell)
DefaultAssay(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct) <- "RNA"
fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- AddModuleScore_UCell(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct,
                                 features = Baron.fib.markers,
                                 assay="RNA", slot = "data")
fib.Baron.markers.names <- paste0(names(Baron.fib.markers),"_UCell")

FeaturePlot(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, 
            features = fib.Baron.markers.names, 
            max.cutoff = "q99", # q## indicates quantile 
            ncol = 2,
            cols = c("lightgrey", "darkred"),
            keep.scale = "all") # to apply the same scale
``` 

### Elyada et al., 2019 - iCAFs, myCAFs and apCAFs program
```{r ext-data-fig-5a-Elyada, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct) <- "RNA"
Elyada <- list() #doi: 10.1158/2159-8290.CD-19-094
Elyada$iCAFs <- c("PLA2G2A","MCL1","S100A10","S100A4","LMNA","UAP1","DPT","ABL2","EFEMP1","TNFAIP6","FBLN2","CCDC80","FSTL1","PTX3","UGDH","IL8","CXCL1","CXCL2","ADH1B","CPE")
Elyada$myCAFs <- c("HOPX","IGFBP7","COL10A1","INHBA","CALD1","BGN","CTHRC1","TPM2","ACTA2","TAGLN","POSTN","TPM1","GRP","CST1","MYL9","MMP11")
Elyada$apCAFs <- c("CD74","SAA3","SLPI", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DRA","HLA-DPA1")

fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct <- AddModuleScore_UCell(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, features= Elyada, 
                                 assay= "RNA", #always use RNA even on the integrated data
                                 slot="data")
Elyada.fib.markers.names <- paste0(names(Elyada),"_UCell")

FeaturePlot(fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct, 
            features = Elyada.fib.markers.names, 
            max.cutoff = "q99", # q## indicates quantile 
            ncol = 2,
            cols = c("lightgrey", "darkred"),
            keep.scale = "all") # to apply the same scale
```

### IL6+ iCAF signature across fibroblast-like cells
```{r ext-data-fig-8e-icaf-signature, fig.width=12, fig.height=4, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Tuvenson's CAF program
iCAFs.deg <- c("C3", "DUSP1", "FBLN1", "LMNA", "CLU","CCDC80","MYC", "EFEMP1","HAS1","NR4A1","CFD","ANXA1","CXCL12","FGF7","KLF4", "EMP1","GPRC5A",

cxcl <-  fib.only.simspec_css.sample.sct@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno_subset == "CAFs_CXCL14+") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()

metadata %>% mutate(Lv.3.Anno = case_when(Lv.2.Anno == "FDCs" ~ "FDCs",
                                          Lv.2.Anno == "FRCs" ~ "FRCs",
                                          Lv.2.Anno == "Pericytes" ~ "Pericytes",
                                          Lv.2.Anno == "Schwann" ~ "Schwann", 
                                          Cell_Ids %in% nrt ~ "CAFs_NRT",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% vsm ~ "Vascular smooth muscle",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% cxcl ~ "CAFs_CXCL14+",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% myo ~ "CAFs_MYO",
                                          TRUE ~ "unassigned")) -> metadata
metadata %>% group_by(Lv.2.Anno) %>% dplyr::count(Lv.3.Anno)
Lv.3.Anno <- metadata$Lv.3.Anno 
names(Lv.3.Anno) <- metadata$S_CB

saveRDS(stromal.subsets, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "stromal.subsets.RDS"))

d <- DotPlot(stromal.subsets, group.by = "Lv.3.Anno", features = iCAFs.deg, col.min = -2, col.max = 10) + RotatedAxis()

ddata <- ddata %>% filter(!is.na(features.plot)) # removing rows with NA
df_spread <- tidyr::spread(ddata[,c(3,4,5)], id, avg.exp.scaled)
rownames(df_spread) <- df_spread[,1]
df_spread <- df_spread[,-1]
mat <- as.matrix(df_spread)

sum(is.infinite(mat)) # to test that there are no infinite values
sum(is.na(mat))

library(pheatmap)
library(viridisLite)
paletteLength <- 50
col <- colorRampPalette(c("steelblue","white","darkred"))(50)
myBreaks <- c(seq(min(mat), 0, length.out=ceiling(paletteLength/2) + 1), 
              seq(max(mat)/paletteLength, max(mat), length.out=floor(paletteLength/2))) # to keep 0 = white color
phet <- pheatmap(t(mat), 
                 color = col, 
                 breaks = myBreaks,
                 fontsize = 9, cluster_cols = T,
                 cellheight = 12,
                 border_color = F,
                 fontsize_row = 12, cutree_cols = 1, cutree_rows = 1,
                 cellwidth = 5, scale = "none")
```

## Transcriptome differences between RETICULAR CELL-like vs CAFs
```{r}
#Ref: https://github.com/yunshun/HumanBreast10X/blob/main/RCode/NormTotal.R
fib <- stromal.subsets %>% subset(subset = Lv.3.Anno %in% c("Vascular smooth muscle", "unassigned"), invert=T)
DefaultAssay(fib) <- "RNA"

# Converting cluster name into numerical
Idents(fib) <- "Lv.2.Anno"
fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno <- as.factor(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno)
print(levels(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
#[1] "CAFs"      "FDCs"      "FRCs"      "Pericytes" "Schwann" 
levels(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) <- 1:length(levels(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
print(1:length(levels(fib$Lv.2.Anno)))
#[1] 1 2 3 4 5
ClusterSub <- as.factor(fib@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) 

PatClust <- paste(fib$Patient_ID, ClusterSub, sep = "_Clst") #labelling each cell with Sample#_Cls#
counts <- fib@assays$RNA@counts #dgCMatrix
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
counts <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group=PatClust))

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
count.matrix <- DGEList(counts) 
count.matrix$samples$Patient <- gsub("_Clst.*$","", colnames(count.matrix)) #adding a new column, named Patient 
count.matrix$samples$Cluster <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*_Clst","",colnames(count.matrix))) #adding a new column, named Cluster
count.matrix$samples$group <- count.matrix$samples$Cluster
count.matrix #count matrix

# Filtering
summary(count.matrix$samples$lib.size)
#Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#    725    8251   43980  435665  300830 7727883 
keep.samples <- count.matrix$samples$lib.size > 2e4
table(keep.samples)
keep.samples
# FALSE  TRUE 
#    25    44
count.matrix <- count.matrix[, keep.samples]

#keep.genes <- filterByExpr(count.matrix, group=count.matrix$samples$Cluster)
#count.matrix <- count.matrix[keep.genes, , keep=FALSE]

# 2 main cell classes: CAFs = 1; FRCs = 3
ClstSub <- count.matrix[,count.matrix$samples$Cluster %in% c("1","3")]  # the CAFs here are all CAFs for downstream analysis, without ambiguous cells
keep <- filterByExpr(ClstSub, group = ClstSub$samples$Cluster,
                     min.count = 5, min.total.count = 10)#min=10, min.total.count=20 # will use #5 to minimise false positive 
table(keep)
# keep
# FALSE  TRUE 
# 14896 11892
ClstSub <- ClstSub[keep, , keep=F]
ClstSub <- calcNormFactors(ClstSub) # to calculate normalisation factors to a algin columns of a count matrix
ClstSub$samples$group

fib.col <- c("#90ADD1", "#92A36F")
plotMDS(ClstSub, pch = 16, col = fib.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")

#Design matrix
Cls <- as.factor(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)
Pat <- factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient)
design <- model.matrix(~0+Cls+Pat)

colnames(design) <- gsub("patient","",colnames(design))
head(design)

#Estimate NB dispersion & QL dispersion
ClstSub <- estimateDisp(ClstSub, design = design, robust=T)
qfit <- glmQLFit(ClstSub, design)
contr <- makeContrasts(Cls3-Cls1,
    levels=design)

FRC.qlf <- glmQLFTest(qfit, contrast=contr)
# Top DE genes, sorted by p-value, with FDR-adjusted p-values
tt <- topTags(FRC.qlf, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "PValue")

### Extracting data table ###
FRC.de <- tt$table
FRC.de$gene <- rownames(FRC.de)
```

## GSEA analysis
```{r}
library("tidyr")
library("msigdbr")
library("clusterProfiler")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
library("ReactomePA")
frc <- FRC.de %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC))
geneList <- frc$logFC # sort according to FC
names(geneList) <- frc$gene # Extract vector of gene symbol

# GSEA use ensemble ID
gene.symbols <- frc$gene
gene.entrez <- bitr(gene.symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", drop = F)
colnames(gene.entrez)[1] <- "gene"
frc <- left_join(frc, gene.entrez, by = "gene")

gene_list <- frc$logFC
names(gene_list) <- frc$ENTREZID

set.seed(1245)
gse <- gsePathway(geneList = gene_list, 
                pvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH", 
                verbose = FALSE)
dotplot(gse, showCategory=30)
res <- gse@result

library(enrichplot)
gseaplot2(gse, geneSetID = c(8,20,30),pvalue_table = TRUE,
          color = c("#DB5D4B","#7872D9","black"))
```

# ENDOTHELIAL
## Subsetting the cell type 
```{r}
sample.high.endothelial <- as.data.frame(sts.non.malignant@meta.data) %>%
        group_by(Sample) %>%
        dplyr::count(Lv.2.Anno) %>% 
        dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Endothelial", n > 30) %>%# pull(n) %>% summary()
        pull(Sample) %>% as.character()

endo <- sts.non.malignant %>% subset(subset = Sample %in% sample.high.endothelial & Lv.2.Anno == "Endothelial")
```

## Diet Seurat
```{r}
DefaultAssay(endo) <- "RNA"
endo <- DietSeurat(endo, assays = "RNA", data = TRUE, counts = TRUE)

# to remove additional columns & because we need to split individual samples and redo the SCT, so we need to remove the "^_SCT"
colnames(endo[[]]) #check which columns to remove
endo[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
endo[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
endo[["seurat_clusters"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.0.5"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.0.6"]] <- NULL
endo[["SCT_snn_res.0.7"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.0.9"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.1"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.1.3"]] <- NULL
#endo[["SCT_snn_res.1.2"]] <- NULL
```

## Normalisation using SCtransform v2
```{r}
endo <- SplitObject(endo, split.by = "Sample")
endo <- lapply(endo, FUN= SCTransform, 
               vst.flavor="v2",
               assay = "RNA",
               variable.features.n = 3000,
               vars.to.regress = "subsets_mito_percent"
               ) # should only use percent.mito
```

## Integration using pearson residuals
```{r}
int.features.split <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = endo, nfeatures = 2000)
endo <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = endo,  anchor.features = int.features.split)

## RPCA integration
endo <- lapply(X = endo, FUN = RunPCA, features = int.features.split, npcs =30)
endo.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = endo, normalization.method = "SCT",
               anchor.features = int.features.split, dims = 1:30, reduction = "rpca", k.anchor = 10) 
endo <- IntegrateData(anchorset = endo.anchors, normalization.method = "SCT", k.weight = 30, dims = 1:30)
```

# Perform integrated analysis
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
DefaultAssay(endo) <- "integrated"
endo <- RunPCA(endo, verbose=F)
ElbowPlot(endo)
DimPlot(endo, reduction = "pca", group.by = "Lv.1.Anno")

endo <- RunUMAP(endo, reduction="pca", dims=1:30, verbose = FALSE)
endo <- FindNeighbors(endo, reduction="pca", dim=1:30)

# testing different algorithm & to determine the resolution of clustering
endo <- FindClusters(endo, algorithm = 3, resolution = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1))

# Use clustree to determine the resolution
library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(endo)  #most stable at resolution = 0.2, 0.4, 0.7, 0.8
#Idents(endo) <- "integrated_snn_res.0.2" # we're keeping it simple, just to seperate LEC from endothelial 
```

# Assigning cluster name
`cell_names` was assigned to the resolution-0.4 clusters by number in the original analysis. It is read from the deposited object (`stage4_endothelial_cell_names`), matched by cell ID; the original mapping is kept as `cell_names_by_cluster` and compared with it.

```{r endothelial-annotation, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Original mapping
metadata <- endo@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() #Creating a data frame called metadata
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)#Assigning S_CB as a new column (CB=cell barcode)
metadata %>% mutate(cell_names = case_when(#integrated_snn_res.0.8 == "0" ~ "Endothelial",
                                           integrated_snn_res.0.4 == "3" ~ "Endothelial:Angiogenic tip cells", #checked
                                           integrated_snn_res.0.4 == "5" ~ "Lymphatic endothelial", #checked
                                           integrated_snn_res.0.4 == "4" ~ "Endothelial:reactive EndMT",#checked and/or antigen-presenting endothelial
                                           integrated_snn_res.0.4 == "2" ~ "Endothelial:Stalk-like", #checked
                                           TRUE ~ "Endothelial:Tip-like")) -> metadata
stopifnot(identical(metadata$S_CB, colnames(endo)))
endo$cell_names_by_cluster <- metadata$cell_names

# cell_names from the deposited object
endo$cell_names <- deposited_labels(endo, "stage4_endothelial_cell_names")
endo@meta.data %>% group_by(integrated_snn_res.0.4) %>% count(cell_names)
print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(endo$integrated_snn_res.0.4, endo$cell_names,
                                    "Endothelial: rerun clusters (res 0.4) vs cell_names", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(endo$cell_names_by_cluster, endo$cell_names,
                                  "Endothelial: cell_names by cluster vs deposited", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
saveRDS(endo, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "endo.RDS"))
```
